prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 28 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1251; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck while turning left. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the impact, and the presenting shoulder complaints fit that history. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the shoulder injury. No prior injury to the same body area is known to this provider. Care was delivered over 28 visits and followed a typical course of rehabilitation, with visit frequency tapering as the patient's range of motion, strength, and pain improved. Billed services correspond to the treatment rendered, with no repeated charges identified. The patient was discharged from active care with a favorable functional outcome and was advised to continue a home exercise program and to return if symptoms recur.
